Hi Maya — glad to meet you. A few quick asks to make the demo productive:

1) Representative request histogram (tokens per request) or a small sample CSV of 1000 request sizes / latencies you’ve observed.
2) Clarify whether 200 qps is sustained, or bursty (e.g., sustained 30m window vs 1–2 minute spikes).
3) Any compliance constraints (VPC/on-prem requirement) we should be aware of for the session.

We typically bring an ops runbook and a small capacity-matrix (to map qps -> instance counts / expected p95), I’ve attached a skeletal capacity-matrix.xlsx and a MAP draft to this thread.

If you prefer Jul 31 morning instead we can swap.
